claims.detail: This omits mandatory APP reimbursement rights under PSR rules (7 October 2024 onwards). A reader who made an authorised bank transfer is entitled to reimbursement, not merely 'possible' recovery dependent on speed. The guide should clarify that reimbursement is a right, not a courtesy.: "If you paid by bank transfer, recovery is less likely but still possible if reported quickly."
